status: preregistered after r24 mechanism test and before endpoint measurement
purpose: Test whether explicitly overlapping the independent cached ffn_gate and ffn_up deterministic oneDNN GEMMs improves the strict c96 TP2 endpoint.
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M, llama.cpp SYCL TP2 tensor 1,1, MTP0, exact F16 cache for ffn_gate and ffn_up, dual-GEMM queue door on, 96 pinned slots, effective total context 49152, batch 2048, ubatch 256, FUSE_EXT=31, temperature 0, prompt cache off, 128 generated token IDs/request, admission target 96 with 1000 ms ceiling.
mechanism_evidence: r24 at A=[1,8704,5120], B=[1,5120,96] measured serial/concurrent pair medians of 0.449041/0.394076 ms on GPU0 and 0.439721/0.384621 ms on GPU1: 12.24% and 12.53% reductions, with gate and up outputs byte-identical on both cards.
oracle: Frozen c96 same-shape batch oracle SHA-256 f0d26606c46b72d8701ca43f113625d5630fa16b17cd8e9db4ea563cbf591ff1; 96 rows.
advance_rule: Attempt 1 must show the dual-GEMM must-fire marker, match the frozen c96 oracle 96/96, pass all isolation/health gates and exceed 192.35094949480367 tok/s. Only then repeat. Promotion requires both attempts 96/96 and their center above 192.34195380893704 tok/s.
failure_policy: Any output mismatch, missing must-fire marker, OOM/health failure or first rate at or below 192.35094949480367 closes r25. No failed-arm or single-run rate is promoted.
